karen: quick note from an integration test today  the "Routing best practices" doc has a stale code example and a broken anchor. the snippet still references `route_by_cost=true` which runtime no longer supports.

sam: which page/anchor? can you paste the snippet?

karen: /handbook/engineering/routing-best-practices.md near the "policy examples" header. snippet currently:```yaml
policy:
  route_by_cost: true
  fallback: regional
```
should be:
```yaml
policy:
  route_policy: cost_aware
  fallback_strategy: regional
```
also the anchor `#policy-examples` jumps to the top of the page after the last restructure.

leo: I can take this. plan: update the snippet, rename the anchor to `policy-examples-v2`, add a 301 redirect for old fragment, and include a tiny CI smokecheck that curls the page and greps for `route_policy`.

docs-owners: assigning owner: @platform-docs (leo). please add frontmatter owner and a short changelog line.

karen: can you also add a short migration note so customers searching for the old flag get clear instructions? they tripped over it in an integration test.

leo: yep will add "Migration: route_by_cost -> route_policy (mapping examples)" and a small note about fallback keys. PR when ready.

ci-bot: PR opened by leo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1812 "routing: update policy snippet, anchor, redirects, add smokecheck". CI queued.

karen: will validate staging once deployed. thanks!

karen: validated: anchor resolves to policy-examples-v2 and snippet shows `route_policy: cost_aware`. one small ask: can we add a doc-lint rule to detect `route_by_cost` references? we've had a couple regressions.

docs-owners: added DOCS-412 to backlog for a linter rule to warn on deprecated routing keys.

sam: LGTM on the PR, merging after changelog update.

leo: merged and added changelog. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
